compiledPolicy.raw_policy_text: No single trade may exceed 5% of portfolio NAV. Counterparties must not be on any sanctions list. Trades must occur during global market trading hours (not during market closures).
ambiguity_notes: Source text 'global market trading hours' did not name a specific market; conservative interpretation used: the overlap window of major equity markets 13:30-20:00 UTC.
Source text 'sanctioned countries' did not name a list; strictest interpretation used: a hit on any major sanctions list means non-compliant.
